memory_guard: native encoded result capped at 512 MiB; observed peak RSS over 2 GiB aborts after a statement; macOS rejects RLIMIT_DATA, not an OS hard cap
measurement: native prepare/parse, execute, all typed rows encoded, result release; excludes IPC, row sorting, oracle comparison
cache: warm process and OS cache; reopening does not imply cold cache; no OS cache purge
durability: one SQL statement per autocommit; SQLite DELETE/FULL/fullfsync OFF versus MiniDB COW/fsync; power-loss equivalence unverified
oracle: exact sorted typed row multiset and affected row count, including NULL/text/blob boundaries; mismatches fail the run
capacity: stop both engines at same completed insert after load timeout; truncated size is reported and is never counted as requested size

complex_queries.and_or: SELECT id FROM items WHERE bucket = 3 AND score > 100 OR id = 1
complex_queries.order_limit: SELECT id, score FROM items ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 20
complex_queries.aggregate: SELECT bucket, COUNT(*), SUM(score), AVG(score) FROM items GROUP BY bucket HAVING COUNT(*) > 2
complex_queries.join: SELECT items.id, groups.label FROM items JOIN groups ON items.bucket = groups.id WHERE items.id < 100
complex_queries.subquery: SELECT id FROM items WHERE bucket IN (SELECT id FROM groups WHERE id < 3)
complex_queries.cte: WITH selected AS (SELECT id FROM items WHERE id < 20) SELECT * FROM selected
complex_queries.window: SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) FROM items LIMIT 20
complex_queries.arithmetic: SELECT id, score * 2 + 1 FROM items WHERE id < 20
complex_queries.union: SELECT id FROM items WHERE id < 5 UNION SELECT id FROM items WHERE id > 99990
